_note: Default parameters. Scripts read this file first, then CLI args override. Change values here to set your preferred defaults.
_start_date_help: Default start date (YYYYMMDD). Override with --start-date CLI.
_end_date_help: Default end date (YYYYMMDD). Override with --end-date CLI. 5m allows ~6 months; 15m allows ~1 year; 60m allows ~5 years.
_max_alphas_help: Default number of alphas per run.
_nan_threshold_help: Max NaN ratio before flagging expression.
